name: Tangle
description: Infrastructure for running, measuring, and deploying AI agents: isolated runtime, model routing, browser evidence, and evaluation.

positioning.primary: Infrastructure for running, measuring, and deploying AI agents.

npm_packages.name: @tangle-network/tcloud
npm_packages.purpose: Router SDK and CLI for model routing, auth headers, and agent service calls.

npm_packages.name: @tangle-network/sandbox
npm_packages.purpose: TypeScript SDK for creating and driving isolated agent sandboxes.

npm_packages.name: @tangle-network/agent-eval
npm_packages.purpose: Trace-first evaluation for rubrics, judges, variants, and promotion gates.

npm_packages.name: @tangle-network/browser-agent-driver
npm_packages.purpose: Browser automation driver and CLI for agentic web tasks.

request.owner_email: optional; Tangle emails this owner the approval link
request.budget_usd: optional lifetime spend cap shared by every granted product, 1-1000, default 25
request.products: optional; default every agent-ready product, or ["*"]

human_inputs: The owner approves the request once.

key.scope: One key for every product the owner approved; use it as Bearer at each product.

signup.payment: Prepaid credit on the owner account. No free credit; paid calls are refused until the owner adds credits.
